coverage.title: What this research edition covers
coverage.note: Monthly public-mirror searches were attempted from January 2011 through October 2026, supplemented by recent main/with-replies timelines and status-page ancestor recovery. This is not an authenticated complete X export.
facts: 9,779 unique recovered account-item metadata records after ID deduplication.
111 sourced summaries, including 25 recovered multi-post sequences. Most ledger records are not turned into lessons: reactions, reposts, social/news posts and unread media remain source metadata.
Actual recovered ID-derived UTC range: 2011-01-26 to 2026-10-24.
Ledger categories: 7681 authored post, 1060 repost, 1015 short reaction, 23 thread opening.
All38 named missing recent own-author ancestors were fetched as individual mirror status-page targets. Explicit ancestor links support recent sequence order.
Initial January2011-November2012 source errors were followed by a successful retry without HTTP errors. A successful search still does not prove every post was returned.
Individual posting dates are calculated from X IDs in UTC; some recent middle posts also have mirror-displayed timestamps. Primary X-displayed timestamps were not independently verified.
